description: This chart compares the distribution of task detections across two different models, labeled (a) and (b). The chart consists of two pie charts, each displaying six slices representing different task categories. In chart (a), the slices are labeled “the”, “this”, “for”, “chemical”, “to”, and “in”, and are colored light blue, pale yellow, light green, dark green, light orange, and dark orange respectively, with proportions of 31%, 21%, 17%, 15%, 15%, and 9%. Chart (b) displays slices labeled “the”, “$”, “equilibrium”, “in”, “to”, and “ill”, colored light blue, pale yellow, light orange, dark green, light green, and dark orange, with proportions of 38%, 27%, 19%, 15%, 9%, and 7%. Both charts include a legend identifying the labels and their corresponding colors, and percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The slices in both charts appear to be ordered from largest to smallest proportion.
